thread:
Lena Ortiz: hey all  Lena here, first week on Platform. following the quickstart and trying to run a tiny test in europe-west3 but i get permission denied when listing instances. not sure who owns regional access vs billing linking. :wave:

Lena Ortiz: gcloud output:```
ERROR: (gcloud.compute.instances.list) PERMISSION_DENIED: User does not have permission to list instances on project redwood-eu-playground
```

Lena Ortiz: i also tried AWS console to check a cross-cloud script and billing shows AccessDenied. kind of stuck on both clouds.

charles_it: welcome Lena! :tada: quickcheck  were you added to infra-eu or just engineering? infra-eu is required for EU project viewer roles and the SSO mapping for AWS billing.

Lena Ortiz: only engineering group AFAIK, filled the onboarding form yesterday.

rahul_cloud: hi! For GCP you need `roles/browser` and `roles/compute.viewer` at minimum to list instances. Billing visibility is separate: you either get `billing.viewer` on the billing account or join the `billing-viewers` SSO group. For AWS consolidated billing we map an org role called `InvoiceViewer` via SSO.

charles_it: i've opened ticket ONB-777 to add you to infra-eu and billing-viewers. infra-bot will track.

infra-bot: Ticket ONB-777 created by charles_it for user Lena Ortiz  "infra-eu + billing-viewers onboarding". Priority: P3. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-777

rahul_cloud: while IT handles SSO, i can grant a short-lived `compute.viewer` on the project so you can proceed with the tutorial. will log expiry.

rahul_cloud: granted `roles/compute.viewer` on redwood-eu-playground to lena.ortiz@redwood.com for 90 minutes.

Lena Ortiz: listing works now, thanks! can SSH into the tiny vm and run the smoke script. :relieved:

Lena Ortiz: AWS billing still blocked, will wait for ONB-777. any way to quickly verify when SSO group propagation completes?

charles_it: run (after a few minutes):```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-eu-playground --filter=bindings.members:lena.ortiz@redwood.com --format=json
```
If you see a binding with infra-eu or billing-viewers you're good. For AWS, try logging into the console and check if Billing -> Overview becomes visible; sometimes SSO propagation takes 5-15m.

Lena Ortiz: noted, thanks. small feedback for the onboarding checklist: could be helpful to add explicit CLI commands for "how to check SSO group membership" and a reminder about folder/billing link gotchas. saved me a few minutes.

charles_it: good feedback  i'll add a one-liner to the doc. we'll close ONB-777 when the SSO mapping and billing access are confirmed.

billing-bot: Billing request created for lena.ortiz@redwood.com  link to billing account billingAccounts/3344-5566-7788 requested. ETA: up to 30 minutes after SSO.

Lena Ortiz: confirmed AWS billing accessible now  looks like the group add propagated. everything working, really appreciate the fast help! :sparkles:

charles_it: welcome aboard Lena! ping #new-hires or #eng-infra if anything else pops up.

infra-bot: ONB-777 updated: SSO group added, billing linked. Closing once propagation verified.
